context_requirements: Dopamine receptor expression, particularly DRD3, which is not a canonical feature of these nine lines
Intact dopamine receptor signaling machinery, which is largely absent or non-functional in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
